blocks.caption: LIVE UPDATES: BARMM parliamentary elections results | Sept. 15, 2026

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Commission on Elections (Comelec) said Tuesday that winners of the regional parliamentary political party (RPPP) race and sectoral representatives in the first Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) parliamentary elections are expected to be proclaimed before midnight.

items: Comelec chair George Garcia said the Comelec could possibly proclaim all winning regional political parties and sectoral representatives in Bangsamoro parliamentary elections before midnight amid reports of poll-related violence and cases of fraud.
Election watchdog Parish Pastoral Council for Responsible Voting (PPCRV) had counted 98.56 percent of the votes cast in the BARMM elections on Tuesday afternoon, Sept. 15.

PPCRV data server as of 1:16 p.m. showed that Bangsamoro Federalist Party is still leading the political party race with 660,464 votes (35.2 percent), followed by the United Bangsamoro Justice Party with 609,078 votes (32.4 percent), Bangsamoro Grand Coalition with 386,033 votes (20.5 percent), and Raayat Democratic Party with 67,855 votes (3.6 percent).
The historic elections will fill the 80-seat parliament, where 40 seats are allocated for party representatives, 32 for district representatives, and eight sectoral representatives./dp
